title: SAP Consumption History
description: Material movement / consumption history extracted from SAP MSEG / MB51. One row per material document line item. Scope: stores and spares material types only (ZSPR, ZSPN) when sourced from SAP.

storage_location.description: MSEG-LGORT. Storage location within the plant.

quantity.description: MSEG-MENGE. Movement quantity in base unit of measure. Signed per movement direction.

unit_of_measure.description: MSEG-MEINS. Base unit of measure, e.g. EA, KG, L.

posting_date.description: MKPF-BUDAT. Posting date of the material document (ISO 8601).

cost_center.description: MSEG-KOSTL. Cost center charged, for consumption movements.

fiscal_year.description: MKPF-GJAHR. Fiscal year of the posting.

period.description: Fiscal period (posting period 1-16) derived from MKPF-MONAT.
